answer: We define a mechanism where agents lock dynamic staking collateral on a basalt ledger, coupled with a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function that yields a temporal echo of legitimacy. When an adversary attempts Sybil multiplication, the subgame-perfect slashing penalty enforces negative expected utility, leaving only a burnt ember of the malicious capital. Consequently, the strategy profile of honest participation converges to a strict Nash equilibrium since the cost of identity replication dominates any payoff.
